title: Designer Natural-Language Design Request v1
description: The body of POST /api/designer/interpret. See docs/bible/12-designer/292-natural-language-input-contract.md and backend/jewelmind/designer/schemas.py::NaturalLanguageDesignRequest.

text.description: The user's natural-language design request or change, in Italian or English.

locale.description: Optional hint only — Designer must produce the same canonical enum values regardless of input language.

interactionMode.description: CREATE starts from JewelMind's schema defaults; MODIFY preserves every unspecified field of currentJDL.

currentJDL.description: The current JewelryDefinition (see specs/jdl/v1/jdl.schema.json), required for a meaningful MODIFY and ignored for CREATE.
